newsitem.title: USA: VideoLan shrugs off analyst short.
newsitem.headline: VideoLan shrugs off analyst short.

text.p: VideoLan Technologies Inc said on Thursday it does not believe that its sales will be materially hurt after an analyst picked the stock as a featured short yesterday, sending the stock lower.

"The recommendation appeared to have been made on the basis of financial market considerations only, and believes it was made without specific knowledge of the company's first product offering, its market positioning, and its current sales successes," VideoLan said in a statement.
It reiterated its earlier statement that the company would post meaningful revenues in the third and fourth quarters and said it is meeting its "targeted and announced objectives".

Yesterday, analyst William Edwards of Palo Alto Investors said in the Wall Street Journal the stock was his featured short over a six month period. VideoLan closed off 1-1/2 to close at 6-3/4 on the Nasdaq after the report.
Shares of VideoLan were off 1/8 to 6-5/8 on Thursday.
